title: AOS Tactical Layer: First Live Use of Experiment Manager
abstract: Activating Task 15 and performing the first live use of the new experiment_manager.py utility. This script will call the manager to create the scaffold for Experiment 002.

original_submission.content:
import subprocess
import sys

# Ensure the new manager can be imported
sys.path.append('storage/telos')
from experiment_manager import create_experiment

# --- Part 1: Update AOS Task List ---
print("--- Activating Task 15 ---")
UPDATE_SCRIPT_PATH = "storage/telos/update_task.py"
subprocess.run(["python", UPDATE_SCRIPT_PATH, "15", "active"], check=True)
print("Task 15 is now active.")

# --- Part 2: Create Experiment 002 ---
print("\\n--- Creating Experiment 002 using the manager ---")

# Parameters for the new experiment
task_id = 15 # This experiment is part of the integration task.
title = "Refactor log_actions.py Utility"
description = "A simple, self-contained experiment to test the new workflow by refactoring an existing utility for better clarity and robustness."
tags = ["aos", "refactor", "workflow-test"]
tick = 42

try:
    exp_dir = create_experiment(task_id, title, description, tags, tick)
    print(f"Experiment 002 created successfully at: {exp_dir}")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"An error occurred while creating the experiment: {e}")
